Schema v2 records genuine database transaction timestamps separately from the core content model; write acknowledgements preserve microseconds and read/list project seconds. Unknown original v1 times remain absent, so original-time import/policy and immutable differential remain open.
List route, original gob cursor, owner-list ordering and visibility, search/index and Runtime before/after hooks remain unfinished.
The existing repository rejects duplicate keys, more than 100 operations, collection/key over 128 UTF-8 bytes and dot/control identifiers. These candidate restrictions differ from upstream.
Invalid/uppercase opaque OCC versions and exact gateway decoder details still require pinned differential; error bodies and headers are not globally qualified.
Blind writes with unchanged value/version and ACL preserve database timestamps; exact upstream differential and independent acceptance remain open.
No durable command receipt exists for storage mutations. An ambiguous commit must not be blindly retried; reconciliation remains open.
Local mocks and source assertions do not establish PostgreSQL/CockroachDB durability, official SDK compatibility, immutable-oracle parity or independent acceptance.
